method: Python 3 unpacked original raw data, calculated stride/end/bounds and every original __text CALL rel32 target. Capstone 4.0.2 x86-32 decoded all cited instructions.

reset.address_calculation: 0x001a9df4 LEA EDX,[EAX+EAX*4]; 0x001a9df7 LEA EDX,[EAX+EDX*2]; 0x001a9dfa LEA EDI,[EDX*4+0x001e2f38]
reset.copy: 0x001a9e01 MOV ESI,0x001e5100; 0x001a9e07 MOV ECX,0xb; 0x001a9e0c REP MOVSD

limit: This identifies selected static setter/reset paths, not all writers. It does not prove call reachability, index/argument values, API semantics, initialization order, runtime table state, additional computed/non-export writers, callback ABI, or lifetime. Labels are hypotheses.
